senses.gloss:
किङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा or -री-रं) A servant.
 E. किं what or something, and
कर who does.

किङ्किणि f. (-णिः or -णी)
 1. A girdle of small bells, or any tinkling orna-
ment.
 2. An acid sort of grape.
 E. किं some, and किण an imitative
sound, affix क, with इन् or ङीष् fem. affix; also with कन् added
किङ्किणीका.

किङ्किर m. (-रः)
 1. The Indian cuckoo, the Koil or Kokila.
 2. A large
black bee.
 3. A horse.
 4. KĀMADEVA.
 f. (-रा) Blood.
 n. (-रं) The
frontal sinus of an elephant.
 E. किं something, कॄ to scatter, क aff.

किङ्किरात m. (-तः)
 1. A name of KĀMADEVA.
 2. A parrot.
 3. The Koil or
Indian cuckoo.
 4. A tree, (Jonesia asoka.)
 5. A species of barleria:
see झिण्टी.
 E. किङ्किर as above, and अत who goes or is.

किङ्किरिन् m. (-री) A plant, commonly Buinchhi, (Flacourtia sapida,
Rox.)
